text:
The plate is square, roughly 26 cm across, and in the photo it spans about 430 px. That gives about 16.5 px per cm.

The corn piece measures about 75 px long (4.5 cm) and about 55 px across (3.5 cm in diameter). As a cylinder that is roughly π × 1.75² × 4.5 ≈ 43 cm³. Cob and kernels together are fairly dense, so I estimate about 45 g.

The corn looks plain, with no visible butter. Boiled corn on the cob runs about 95 kcal per 100 g, and the cob lowers that slightly, so I use 90.
